breakdown.description: A number-average molecular weight smaller than the repeat-unit molecular weight, which would imply a degree of polymerization below 1 for a polymer chain.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to identify and correct the physically impossible values. The original prompt stated a number-average molecular weight (M_n = 78 g/mol) that was smaller than the repeat-unit molecular weight (M_0 = 104 g/mol), which is impossible for a polymer. The ground truth corrects this by changing M_n to 7,800 g/mol. The agent, however, repeated the incorrect values verbatim in its generated specification, failing to resolve the core issue.
